newsitem.title: USA: CACI to get $40 mln a year for 5 years in contract.
newsitem.headline: CACI to get $40 mln a year for 5 years in contract.

text.p: CACI International Inc said Tuesday it expects to receive $40 million a year for the next five years under a litigation support services contract the U.S. Department of Justice awarded it.

Under the contract, known as "Mega 1", CACI will provide the services to the Justice Department's Antitrust, Civil, Civil-Rights and Criminal divisions. The services are aimed at helping attorneys better organize and present evidence, CACI said.
CACI did not say when the contract was slated to begin, although added that it expects to receive orders for new work as part of the contract start-up. It did not quantify those potential orders.
Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment.
